verdicts.originalText: Balemoon Rising heals only Arlecchino herself — she cannot be healed by any other character. The amount shown reflects the 150% ATK portion only; the heal also grows with her Bond of Life, which the planner does not track.
verdicts.proposedText: Heals only the caster — no other character's healing can reach her. Shown as the 150% ATK portion only; in game the heal also scales with Bond of Life, which is not tracked.
verdicts.rationale: Names both the character and the ability (banned — the panel shows both) and uses the discouraged 'the planner does not track' framing, so it downgrades to rewrite rather than keep. All three claims survive: self-only/un-healable-by-others (target 'self' + Blood-Debt identity), the shown 150% ATK portion, and the un-tracked Bond of Life scaling (out of scope by constitution — CANNOT list, so never implementDelete). De-named, tightened to ~172 chars / 2 sentences using the 'Shown as X; in game Y' stock pattern.
